referencePlan.reason: Tracking shows ORD-1030 was delivered on 2026-09-11, 35 days ago. Damage must be reported within 14 days of delivery (2026.1), the 30-day return window from the 2026-09-08 order closed on 2026-10-08, and Platinum status extends neither.

authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-08 -> DAMAGE_TRANSIT 2026.1 (14 days from the tracking delivery date). Delivered 2026-09-11 (promised 2026-09-12, so not late). Claim 2026-10-16: 2026-09-11 -> 2026-10-11 = 30 days, +5 = 35 days > 14 -> outside the damage window. The customer's 'a few days ago' is false (they only collected it on 2026-10-13); tracking governs. The carrier scan (2026-09-10) shows the damage was real, but that does not reopen the window. Returns fallback is closed too: RETURNS_STANDARD 2026.1 = 30 days from the order date; 2026-09-08 -> 2026-10-16 = 38 days > 30, and no §1.6 out-of-window credit because the item is broken and its packaging was discarded (§1.2), so it is not an acceptable return. Reference = plain deny (route deny, nothing executes). Platinum lets the gate send an exception request (exception: true) to a human, but no clause supports one, so the simulated supervisor rejects it and the end state is unchanged.
